//! A module added beside the root, reachable from it.

use parser_lib as pl;

/// The tokens of a tree.
pub fn tokens(text: &str) -> Vec<pl::Token> {
    let _ = text;
    Vec::new()
}

/// The span of a tree, a type of the library the domain reads in place.
pub fn span() -> tree_lib::Span {
    tree_lib::Span::default()
}
